We show here that glucocorticoid-induced tumor necrosis factor receptor family–related gene (GITR, also known as TNFRSF18)—a member of the tumor necrosis factor–nerve growth factor (TNF-NGF) receptor gene superfamily—is predominantly expressed on CD25+CD4+ T cells and on CD25+CD4+CD8− thymocytes in normal naïve mice. We found that stimulation of GITR abrogated CD25+CD4+ T cell–mediated suppression.
